recipes.name: Classic Roast Whole Chicken
steps: Pat the chicken very dry. Dry-brine with the salt 12-24 h uncovered in the fridge if you can, or at least 1 h.
Heat oven to 425F. Stuff the cavity with lemon, garlic and thyme; tie the legs.
Rub with butter or oil and pepper. Roast 20 min, then drop to 375F and roast 40-60 min until breast 165F and thigh 175F.
Rest 15-20 min before carving.
recipes.notes: A 4 lb bird gives about 1.5 lb cooked meat. Scaling: one bird per 4 servings; roast two birds side by side without changing time.

recipes.name: Spatchcock (Butterflied) Roast Chicken
steps: Cut out the backbone with kitchen shears; flip and press the breastbone flat.
Salt, rub and oil. Rest 30 min, or overnight in the fridge.
Roast skin-up on a rack over a sheet pan at 450F for 45-50 min to 165F breast / 175F thigh.
Rest 10 min and carve.
recipes.notes: Even cooking and very crisp skin. Save the backbone for stock.

recipes.name: Vertical (Beer-Can Style) Roast Chicken
ing: beer can or a vertical roaster stand
steps: Rub the chicken. Sit it upright on the can or roaster.
Roast at 375F for 60-90 min until thigh 175F.
Rest 15 min.
recipes.notes: The beer does not steam the meat; the benefit is even, upright cooking.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Bone-In Thighs and Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and half the salt; roast 10 min.
Pat thighs dry, season with the rest of the salt and spices, and set skin-up among the potatoes.
Roast 35-45 min until thighs reach 175F.
Rest 5 min.
recipes.notes: Potatoes add about 140 kcal and 30 g carbs per serving. Use two pans above 8 servings so nothing crowds.

recipes.name: Crispy-Skin Thighs (Sear then Roast)
steps: Salt thighs and refrigerate uncovered 1-24 h.
Heat oven to 450F. Place thighs skin-down in an oven-safe skillet with the oil over medium heat.
Cook 8-10 min until the skin is deep golden; flip.
Roast 12-15 min to 175F. Rest the chicken; deglaze the pan with broth and mustard for a sauce.
recipes.notes: Best crisp skin, but not a batch method: use one skillet per 4 thighs.

recipes.name: Crispy Baked Drumsticks
steps: Pat drumsticks very dry; toss with baking powder, salt and rub.
Set on a rack over a sheet pan; refrigerate uncovered 1-12 h if you have time.
Roast at 425F, turning once, 35-45 min until 175F.
recipes.notes: Baking powder raises skin pH for browning and crackle.

recipes.name: Oven-Fried Chicken
steps: Brine chicken in buttermilk, salt and hot sauce 4-12 h.
Heat oven to 425F with a rack on a sheet pan; oil the rack.
Dredge in the seasoned flour, shake off extra, place on the rack and spray with oil.
Bake 35-45 min, flipping once, until 175F.
recipes.notes: Flour coating adds about 60-90 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Buttermilk Skillet-Fried Chicken
ing: neutral oil for frying (about 3 cups; most stays in the pan)
steps: Brine chicken in buttermilk and salt 4-12 h.
Dredge in flour and spices, pressing on.
Fry in 350F oil, about 12-15 min per side for bone-in, until 175F.
Drain on a rack.
recipes.notes: Absorbs oil; add about 100-150 kcal per serving. Fry in batches; do not crowd.

recipes.name: Grilled Lime-Cilantro Thighs
steps: Marinate the chicken in everything else 2-6 h.
Grill on medium-high 5-6 min per side to 175F.
Rest 5 min and slice.
recipes.notes: Slice for bowls, tacos or salads.

recipes.name: Pounded Grilled Chicken Breast
steps: Pound breasts to an even 3/4 in.
Season all over with salt, garlic powder and pepper; rest 30 min. (For extra juiciness, brine 30 min in 1 tbsp salt per cup of water instead.)
Oil the grate. Grill medium-high 5-7 min per side to 160F; rest 5 min to reach 165F.
Serve with lemon.
recipes.notes: Even thickness prevents dry ends.

recipes.name: Chicken Kebabs
ing: boneless thighs, cut in 1.5 in cubes
steps: Mix yogurt, lemon, garlic, oregano and salt; coat chicken and marinate 4-12 h.
Thread onto skewers with peppers and onion (soak wooden skewers 30 min).
Grill medium-high 10-14 min, turning, until 175F.
recipes.notes: Great cold in bowls the next day.

recipes.name: Tandoori-Style Yogurt Chicken
steps: Score the chicken; coat with everything else and refrigerate 4-12 h.
Roast at 450F on a rack 35-45 min to 175F, then broil 3 min for char.
recipes.notes: Serve with rice and cucumber-yogurt.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken (weeknight)
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala and half the salt 30 min to 4 h.
Sear chicken in batches; set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic and ginger; add tomatoes and remaining spice; simmer 10 min.
Add cream and butter, return chicken and simmer 10 min to 175F.
recipes.notes: Sauce adds about 150-200 kcal per serving. Freezes 3 months.

recipes.name: Coconut Chicken Curry
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and paste 2 min.
Add coconut milk, chicken and salt; simmer 20-25 min to 175F.
Add vegetables in the last 5 min.
recipes.notes: Coconut milk adds about 150-250 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Rice Bowls
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, lemon and salt 4-12 h.
Broil on a rack 8-10 min per side to 175F.
Serve on rice with cucumber and cilantro.
recipes.notes: Rice adds about 200 kcal per cup.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Teriyaki Chicken and Broccoli
steps: Marinate chicken in soy, mirin, sugar, ginger, garlic 2-6 h; reserve a few tablespoons of extra marinade and simmer 5 min as sauce.
Roast chicken at 425F 20-25 min; add broccoli for the last 15.
Serve over rice with sauce.
recipes.notes: Sauce adds about 60-80 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Korean Gochujang Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in everything except scallions and seeds 2-8 h.
Roast at 425F 20-25 min, brushing with reserved glaze in the last 5 min.
Top with scallions and sesame.
recipes.notes: Sugars scorch above 425F; watch closely.

recipes.name: Velveted Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
steps: Toss chicken with 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp oil; rest 15-30 min.
Sear chicken in a very hot pan in 2 batches, 2-3 min each; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables 3-4 min with ginger and garlic.
Whisk sauce ingredients, add with the chicken and toss 1-2 min until glossy and 165F.
recipes.notes: Sauce and oil add 100-150 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Toss chicken with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy; rest 15 min.
Toast chilies briefly in hot oil; add chicken and sear 4-5 min.
Add garlic, ginger, remaining soy, vinegar and sugar; toss 1 min.
Finish with peanuts and scallions.
recipes.notes: Peanuts add about 80-100 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Cutlets with Pan Sauce
steps: Pound cutlets to 1/2 in; season and dredge lightly in flour.
Sear 3 min per side until 165F; remove.
Deglaze the pan with broth and lemon; add garlic; reduce 3 min; whisk in butter and parsley.
recipes.notes: Flour, oil and butter add about 80-120 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Dredge and sear cutlets as above; remove.
Add wine or broth and lemon; reduce by half.
Add capers and butter; return chicken and warm through.
recipes.notes: Serve over pasta or rice.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Parmesan
steps: Dip cutlets in egg, then in panko mixed with parmesan and salt; set on a rack.
Bake 425F 15-18 min.
Top with sauce and mozzarella; bake 5 min more until 165F.
recipes.notes: Sauce, cheese and coating add about 250-300 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Salt and brown thighs skin-side down 6-8 min; remove.
Sauté vegetables; add garlic, tomatoes, wine and oregano.
Nestle the chicken in the sauce, cover, and simmer 35-45 min to 175F.
recipes.notes: Freezes 3 months. Liquid scales by pot depth, not volume, when going past 8 servings.

recipes.name: Red Wine Braised Chicken (coq au vin style)
steps: Brown bacon, then the salted chicken; remove.
Sauté vegetables; add wine and herbs; return chicken.
Braise covered at 325F 45-50 min; reduce the sauce and serve with potatoes.
recipes.notes: Wine adds about 60-80 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
steps: Marinate 30 min to overnight.
Simmer chicken in the marinade, covered, 30-35 min.
Uncover, reduce the sauce, and broil the skin 3-4 min for browning.
recipes.notes: Improves overnight. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Peruvian-Style Roast Chicken with Green Sauce
steps: Mix lime, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, oil and salt; coat chicken and marinate 4-12 h.
Roast at 425F 45-55 min to 175F.
Blend cilantro, jalapeno, mayo, yogurt and a squeeze of lime for the green sauce.
recipes.notes: Sauce adds about 80-120 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken
steps: Mix everything into a paste; coat chicken; marinate 4-24 h.
Roast at 400F 50-60 min to 175F, or grill over indirect heat.
recipes.notes: Serve with rice and beans.

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
steps: Toss potatoes with half the oil, lemon, oregano and salt in a roasting pan with the broth.
Rub chicken with the rest and set on top.
Roast 425F 50-60 min, basting once, until 175F.
recipes.notes: Potatoes absorb the drippings.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Marinate 4-12 h.
Roast at 450F 20-25 min, broil 2-3 min for edges.
Slice; serve in bowls or pitas with garlic yogurt.
recipes.notes: Great for bowls.

recipes.name: Moroccan-Style Chicken with Olives
ing: preserved lemon or the zest of 1 lemon
steps: Rub chicken with the spices and salt; brown skin-side down; remove.
Sauté onion; add broth, olives and lemon; return chicken.
Braise covered 35-40 min to 175F; serve on couscous.
recipes.notes: Serves well with a cucumber salad.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
steps: Stir-fry garlic and chilies 30 seconds; add chicken and cook to 165F.
Add fish sauce, soy and sugar; toss in basil until wilted.
Serve over rice with a fried egg.
recipes.notes: Ground chicken is slightly lower in protein than breast; treat macros as approximate.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Marinate chicken in coconut milk, curry, turmeric and soy 2-8 h; thread on skewers.
Grill or broil 3-4 min per side.
Stir peanut butter, soy, lime, sriracha and warm water into a sauce.
recipes.notes: Peanut sauce adds about 130-200 kcal.

recipes.name: Shredded Salsa Chicken Tacos
steps: Slow cook chicken, salsa and seasoning on LOW 3-5 h (breast on the short side); shred.
Crisp the shredded meat under the broiler 3 min if you like edges.
Serve in warm tortillas.
recipes.notes: Tortillas add about 50-60 kcal each. Slow cooker: fill only half to two-thirds.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl Meal Prep
steps: Rub chicken with seasoning and salt; sear or roast at 425F 20-25 min; dice.
Portion chicken, 1 cup rice, 1/2 cup beans, corn and salsa into 4 containers.
Reheat 90 seconds; add lime.
recipes.notes: Beans add about 110 kcal and 7 g protein per 1/2 cup.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss everything except limes and tortillas on a sheet pan.
Roast at 450F 18-22 min.
Squeeze lime over; serve in tortillas or bowls.
recipes.notes: Oil adds about 60 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Shredded Chicken Quesadillas
steps: Layer chicken, cheese and salsa on half of each tortilla; fold.
Cook in a dry skillet 2-3 min per side until crisp.
recipes.notes: Cheese and tortillas add about 250 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken (bowls or wraps)
steps: Bake chicken at 425F 18-22 min (or poach); shred or slice.
Melt butter with hot sauce and toss with the chicken.
Serve with celery, carrots and yogurt dip, or over rice.
recipes.notes: Butter adds about 50 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Dijon-Maple Chicken Thighs
steps: Mix mustard, syrup, oil, thyme and salt; coat chicken; marinate 2-6 h.
Roast at 425F 40-45 min, brushing once, to 175F; add beans for the last 15 min.
recipes.notes: Sugar browns quickly; tent with foil if too dark.

recipes.name: Oven BBQ Chicken
steps: Rub chicken with sugar, spices and salt.
Roast at 400F 30-35 min.
Brush with sauce; roast 10 min more to 175F.
recipes.notes: Sauce adds about 80 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Smoked Chicken Thighs
steps: Season chicken.
Smoke at 250-275F 90-120 min.
Raise heat to 400F for the last 10-15 min for crisp skin; pull at 175-185F.
recipes.notes: Dark meat handles smoke well.

recipes.name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs
steps: Dry the thighs; rub with oil and seasoning.
Air fry at 380F skin-down 12 min, flip and cook 10-14 min more to 175F.
recipes.notes: Batch size is limited by basket: cook in rounds.

recipes.name: Air Fryer Wings
steps: Pat dry; toss with baking powder and salt.
Air fry at 400F 20-25 min, flipping halfway; toss in sauce.
recipes.notes: Wings are mostly bone and skin; USDA raw is 191 kcal, 17.5 g protein, 12.8 g fat per 100 g. About 5 wings per serving.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Chicken Thighs
steps: Add everything to the slow cooker.
Cook LOW 4-5 h to 175F; shred or slice.
recipes.notes: Bone-in takes 6-7 h on LOW.

recipes.name: Pressure Cooker Shredded Chicken
steps: Cook on high pressure 10 min (fresh) or 12-15 min (frozen); natural release 10 min.
Shred with two forks and return to the juices.
recipes.notes: Cooking time depends on piece size, not on quantity.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer chicken and vegetables 30-40 min; remove chicken.
Shred the meat and return to the pot with noodles; cook 6-8 min.
recipes.notes: Freezes well without the noodles.

recipes.name: Chicken Stock from Carcass
steps: Cover with cold water and bring to a bare simmer.
Simmer 3-4 h (or pressure 45-60 min); skim.
Strain, chill, and remove the fat. Refrigerate 3-4 days or freeze 4 months.
recipes.notes: Free protein and collagen from what you would throw away.

recipes.name: High-Protein Chicken Salad
steps: Mix everything.
Refrigerate up to 3 days; do not freeze.
recipes.notes: Yogurt adds about 30-40 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Meatballs
steps: Mix gently and roll into 1.5 in balls.
Bake at 400F 15-18 min to 165F.
recipes.notes: Ground chicken is lean; the egg and crumbs keep it moist. Macros are approximate.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in the oil; set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables; add rice and break up clumps; add chicken and soy.
Fold in eggs and sesame oil.
recipes.notes: Rice adds about 300 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Lighter Chicken Pasta (Greek yogurt sauce)
steps: Cook pasta; keep 1 cup of the water.
Sear chicken; add garlic and spinach.
Off heat, stir in yogurt and parmesan with pasta water.
recipes.notes: Do not boil the yogurt or it splits.

recipes.name: Lemon-Pepper Oven Wings
steps: Toss wings with baking powder and salt; rack on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425F 40-45 min, flipping once.
Toss with butter, zest, juice and pepper.
recipes.notes: Cook in a single layer; use two pans above 4 lb.

recipes.name: Honey-Garlic Chicken Thighs
steps: Whisk honey, soy, garlic, vinegar and pepper; coat chicken 30 min to 4 h.
Roast at 425F 20-25 min with green beans for the last 15, to 175F.
recipes.notes: Sauce adds about 60-70 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Cajun Chicken and Rice Skillet
steps: Toss chicken with half the seasoning; brown in the oil; remove.
Sauté vegetables; add rice, remaining seasoning and broth.
Return chicken; cover and simmer 18 min; rest 5 min.
recipes.notes: Rice water ratio here is 2:1 because of the vegetables; keep the lid on.

recipes.name: One-Pot Chicken and Rice
steps: Salt thighs; brown skin-side down 6-8 min; remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in the fat; add rice, spices and broth.
Set thighs on top, cover and cook on low 25-30 min to 175F; rest 5 min.
recipes.notes: Rice cooks in the chicken juices; one pot to wash.

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
steps: Melt butter, sauté onion and carrots; stir in flour 1 min.
Add broth and milk; simmer 10 min until thickened.
Add chicken, peas, thyme and salt; heat through.
recipes.notes: Freezes 3 months.

recipes.name: Low-Fat Poached Chicken and Rice (long-run meal)
steps: Combine warm.
Eat 3-4 h before a long run or the night before.
recipes.notes: Low-fat, low-fiber. See guides/sports-nutrition.md.
